description: Continuous-LoRa example using formula (2.7) and experimental data from Dudarek and Martyniuk's pre-print on discrete-to-continuous LoRa parameter estimation.

class_sf.label: Nominal class SF (detected vs GT SF)

class_bw.label: Nominal class BW (detected vs GT BW)

measured_bw.label: Measured BW (box estimate vs GT BW)

class_bw within tol & sf wrong.label: Class BW within 10% of GT BW but class SF wrong
class_bw within tol & sf wrong.condition: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10 and col('Class SF') != col('GT SF')

rows.class_ok: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10
